channel.title: Flying Star Aviator — DGCA and pilot training guides
channel.description: Sourced guides to DGCA examinations, licences and pilot training in India, from Flying Star Aviator, Dwarka, New Delhi.

item.title: Cadet Pilot Programme vs Self-Sponsored CPL: What Differs
item.description: A cadet pilot programme and a self-sponsored CPL lead to the same DGCA licence. What differs: selection timing, cost structure, type rating and service bonds.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Exam Pass Rate 2026: The Data DGCA Actually Publishes
item.description: DGCA does not publish a CPL or ATPL exam pass rate. What the regulator's FAQ and CAR actually state, and how to judge your own readiness instead.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: CPL Eligibility After 12th: What DGCA Requires
item.description: DGCA requires 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics for CPL exams, not PCM, and sets no maximum age. What the rules say, and what they leave to the airlines.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Exam Validity: How Long a Cleared Paper Lasts
item.description: A cleared CPL or ATPL paper is valid five years, a PPL paper two and a half. DGCA publishes no attempt cap — the real limit is validity plus a fee per try.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Licence Conversion: Documents and Currency Checklist
item.description: What DGCA requires to convert a foreign pilot licence: a current rating with 10 hours PIC in 24 months, Indian written exams, and a skill test in India.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: RTR(A) Exam 2026: What Changes Now DGCA Runs It, Not WPC
item.description: RTR(A) moved from WPC to DGCA under the 2025 rules. What actually changed in eligibility and exam structure, and which figures we could not verify.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: Cabin Crew Salary India: What Airlines Actually Publish
item.description: No Indian airline publishes cabin crew salary figures. What the pay is made of, what Air India does publish, and how to read the numbers you find online.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA OLODE vs Regular Exams: What Actually Differs
item.description: DGCA runs Flight Crew papers in fixed sessions and on-demand OLODE slots. What differs, what a paper costs, and why the Rs 5,000 figure is unsourced.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Exam Myths: What the Rules Actually Say
item.description: PCM is not required. There is no upper age limit. Ground classes are not mandatory. DGCA exam myths corrected against the regulator's own published rules.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Board Verification Certificate: Who Needs One
item.description: A Board Verification Certificate is mandatory for every NEW DGCA Flight Crew candidate before registration. What it certifies and who is exempt.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Exam Fees: Rs 2,500 Per Paper, Non-Refundable
item.description: DGCA states Rs 2,500 per paper for Flight Crew examinations, never refundable. No separate OLODE fee is published. What that means for budgeting a CPL.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Exam Subjects: PPL vs CPL vs ATPL
item.description: Which DGCA theory papers each licence requires, the qualification to appear, the 70% pass mark and how long a cleared paper stays valid. One sourced table.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: ATPL Eligibility in India: Requirements Explained
item.description: A DGCA ATPL applicant must already hold an Indian CPL, and an ATPL is not issued on a single-engine aircraft. Subjects, pass marks and the defence route.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: How to Choose DGCA Ground Classes: A 12-Question Checklist
item.description: DGCA does not accredit ground coaching institutes. 12 questions to verify on faculty, mock tests, single-paper pricing and exit terms before you pay one.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team
item.category: How to Choose DGCA Ground Classes

item.title: How to Choose a Flying School in India: A Verify-First Guide
item.description: Skip the Top 10 lists. Verify DGCA approval, recent utilisation, fee exit terms and logbook practice before you pay a flying school in India.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team

item.title: DGCA Ground Classes vs Self-Study 2026: Are They Mandatory?
item.description: DGCA ground classes are not mandatory. Ground classes vs self-study for the CPL theory papers: exam fees, the 70% pass mark, and who each route suits.
item.dc:creator: Flying Star Aviator Academics Team
